title: When using DexShare or Nightscout follow, WearOS integration breaks
body:
The native xdrip+ watch face "Circle" displays a glucose of 999 and doesn't update, and the complication shows NULL/NULL only.
This is using the nightly from the 19th of may.
Data shows correctly on the Widget and main app.
